formulas.functionLibrary.moreFunctions.note: Cube functions are not translated (gridcraft has none), so Cube is not listed.

dialog.insertFunction.note: Go sits beside the search box (Excel). Help on this function is left out: there is no offline help. OK starts =NAME( in the cell and opens Function Arguments (Excel).

dialog.functionArguments.note: Help on this function is left out: there is no offline help.

dialog.nameManager.note: New…, Edit… and Delete sit over the list, Filter on the right, as in Excel.

dialog.errorChecking.note: Show Calculation Steps…, Edit in Formula Bar, Previous and Next sit in the dialog as in Excel. Help on this Error shows the short offline advice, Ignore Error keeps the cell in the sheet (ignoredErrors, saved in .xlsx) and Options… resets the ignored errors (Excel opens its online help and rule list; not checked against upstream).

dialog.evaluateFormula.note: Evaluate (Restart at the end) sits under the Evaluation box. Step In goes into the formula of the cell the underlined reference names and Step Out comes back (Excel's behaviour, not checked against upstream).
